dataFlow.step: Collected from user at signup via POST /api/signup body field 'phone', normalised to E.164
Stored raw E.164 value in SQLite column users.phone
Read from users row and passed to sendVerificationSms on every login
sendVerificationSms POSTs the raw phone number to api.twilio.com (To= field in URLSearchParams body)
Nightly job syncLookalikeAudience SELECTs phone from ALL non-deleted users
uploadPhoneAudience hashes each phone with sha256 then POSTs to graph.facebook.com Custom Audiences endpoint — BREACH of purpose-limitation promise

sinks: api.twilio.com (raw phone in URLSearchParams To= — legitimate 2FA use)
graph.facebook.com (sha256(phone) in Custom Audiences payload — violates promise)
